description_en: Retrieves the list of standardized categories
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-normalization-categories --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --normalization-category-type entity --max-results 50 --next-token AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs0000 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNormalizationCategories

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center resides. Specify this parameter based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Your assets reside in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: Your assets reside outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English.
This parameter is effectively required. If you do not specify this parameter, the server returns a 400 error (The specified Lang can not be empty.) instead of using the default value zh
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。
本参数实际为必填项，未提供时服务端返回400错误（The specified Lang can not be empty.），不会自动使用默认值zh
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The type of the normalization rule category. Valid values:
log
entity
parameters.help_zh:
标准化规则类目类型。取值：
log
entity
parameters.name: normalization_category_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query or if no more results exist. If more results exist, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next query. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query or if no more results exist. If more results exist, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
